name: CHiME-6 Speech Separation and Recognition Challenge
description: A noisy multi-speaker speech separation and recognition challenge based on real-world recordings from domestic environments, testing both source separation and speech transcription under overlap and reverberation.
evaluation_method: speech separation metrics plus word error rate for recognition output
typical_sota_score: substantially improved over early baselines, but WER remains relatively high due to overlap, noise, and reverberation in conversational settings
notes: CHiME-6 is notably challenging because it uses real conversational speech in unconstrained home environments. It is frequently used to benchmark robust ASR, diarization, and separation pipelines.
